items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: Lew told him too, he said, 'This theater is much too big for me alone, as one person and trumpet player,' and he'd have to find someone, so he said, he asked Luke, 'Do you musicians well enough to choose what I wanted, so I just decided to disband, and go with Sissle, because Sissle paid me so much

ctx.x: So then what, you were playing around Paris, now --

Yes, yes. I played after I finished, it happened that Lew Leslie's Blackbirds came to the Moulin Rouge Theatre on Place Blanche, and I had a very, very fine friend who was with -- a trombone player -- who was with the New York 15th Division, with Lt. James Reese -- yes.
